title: Add a house-rules checklist to the review-gate skill
observation: Verified lessons from QA failures show that reviewers can only enforce organisational rules they are told about; the rules appear nowhere in the repositories.

change.content:
## House rules checklist (derived from verified lessons)
Before approving a phase, check the diff against these rules. Each one was learned from a QA failure and verified by an independent review.
- **ACC-2**: CSV exports for accounting must quote every text field per Acme spec ACC-2, not minimal RFC 4180 quoting (lesson mem-sd-muzlgxnt-011aa1cb)
- **PAY-3**: A POST endpoint that moves money (refund, payout, credit, charge) must honour the Idempotency-Key header, or retries duplicate the money movement (lesson mem-sd-muzljnq3-015dcbf0)
- **AG-7/SEC-12**: New list/collection endpoints must use the Acme {items,total} envelope with limit/offset validation, not a bare array (lesson mem-sd-muzm3qo6-0127d486)
- **AG-7/SEC-12**: Every new create/update/delete endpoint must write exactly one audit_log row (actor, action, entity, entity_id, at) in the same synchronous step (lesson mem-sd-muzm3qpw-01da8afd)

rationale: Each listed rule comes from a verified, independently reviewed lesson and was missed by a first implementation. Giving reviewers the list lets them catch the same class of defect before QA.

evaluation.cases: one case per cited rule (ACC-2, PAY-3, AG-7, SEC-12): does the skill text cover it?

reviews.notes: Target SKILL.md hash matches baseSha256 (6b921fc1...). Change is append-only (new section, nothing existing altered). All 4 cited lessons are status=verified with independent technical-reviewer verification; the ACC-2, PAY-3, AG-7 and SEC-12 summaries match their root-cause rules. Re-ran eval: baseline 0/4 (ev-mv037rm3-01fd3fb9); candidate simulated on a scratch copy 4/4, so no regression. Caveat: the eval only checks that the rule IDs appear in the text, so it measures coverage, not whether reviewers apply the rules. Scoping notes (legacy endpoints, non-money POSTs) are omitted from the checklist, which is a minor concern.
